conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Once upon a time, there lived BOB.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: BOB worked at growing barley and turning it into malt.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Because he loved beer so much, he put his heart and soul into creating the malts for the most delicious beer possible.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: His dream was to one day open a beer pub and sell beer made from his own malt.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: However, it was not easy to get a shop because of the skyrocketing rent.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Then, a lucky fairy appeared before him.

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: Hello, buddy! My name is MALT! I'm the malt you created with love!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Oh my goodness! I'm not seeing things, am I?

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: Of course not! I know your troubles. I'll provide a solution for you!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Good heavens, thank you so much! What is the solution?

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: It's to open a shop deep inside an abandoned dungeon! There's no owner, so it's free!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: What! But the dungeon must have been locked tight a long time ago?

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: Don't worry! I can open it with my magic powers!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Oh, you truly are a lovely MALT. Alright, let's head out right now!
